# mammoth 1.13.0 (its browser build), for reading Word documents

**What it is:** Michael Williamson's .docx reader, which turns a Word document into clean HTML by its meaning (headings
stay headings, lists stay lists, bold and italic stay) rather than its look. Ghosty uses it on the phone to read a Word
file as a document and to convert Word to text or a web page (`apps/web/src/docs/read.ts`, `apps/web/src/convert/vendor.ts`).
Nothing is sent anywhere.

**Package:** `mammoth@1.13.0` from the npm registry (its author's own distribution), fetched on 1 November 2026.
